topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture on complement and sets expectations regarding its complexity and nomenclature.

topics.label: Foundational principles and architecture of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the fundamental framework and operating principles of the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct pathways that recognize pathogens and initiate complement activation.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the primary downstream effector mechanisms by which complement eliminates pathogens.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how regulatory proteins protect host cells from unintended complement destruction.

topics.label: Clinical complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct clinical presentations and pathology associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the mechanisms by which pathogens evade complement-mediated destruction, highlighting Staphylococcus aureus as a case study.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic in the course.
